about: 관리 > 근태입력(E020710) 사원 기준 — 원본처럼 [사원] 은 사원등록의 사원 코드도움이고(계정이 없는 사원도 넣는다), 근태일자 하나 · 결재 없이 저장하면 곧바로 잡힌다. QA관리-사원(계정 없음)에 올해 휴가항목 15일 부여 → 근태입력 연차 1일 → 근태조회 1.00 · 근태현황 사원 줄 1.00 · 휴가잔여 15.000 / 1.000 / 14.000 · 휴가사용실적 잔여 14.000 → 근태조회 [근태번호] 수정 창에서 2일 → 2.00 · 잔여 13.000 → [선택삭제] 뒤 잔여 15.000 으로 되돌아옴. 시험 자료는 지운다.

shots.name: 근태입력 — 사원 코드도움으로 연차 1일 저장
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const y=new Date().getFullYear();const e=await (await fetch('/api/employees',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({code:'QAGL-AT1',name:'QA관리-사원'})})).json();const v=await (await fetch('/api/hr/vacation-kinds',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:'QA관리-휴가A',periodFrom:y+'-01-01',periodTo:y+'-12-31',carryOver:false})})).json();const k=await (await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:'QA관리-연차A',type:'VACATION',vacationKindId:v.id,hourUnit:false})})).json();const g=await fetch('/api/hr/vacation-kinds/'+v.id+'/grants',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify([{employeeId:e.id,carryOverDays:0,currentDays:15}])});sessionStorage.setItem('qaLe',JSON.stringify({e:e.id,v:v.id,k:k.id,code:v.code}));return (e.id&&v.id&&k.id&&g.ok)?true:JSON.stringify([e,v,k])})()

shots.name: 근태조회 [근태번호] 수정 창 — 2일
steps: js:(()=>{const ds=document.querySelectorAll('.ec-modal input[type=date]');const s=ds[0].value;const n=new Date(s+'T00:00:00');n.setDate(n.getDate()+1);const v=n.getFullYear()+'-'+String(n.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(n.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(ds[1],v);ds[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));ds[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return true})()

shots.name: 휴가잔여 — 지운 뒤 잔여 15 로 되돌아옴 → 정리
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const q=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qaLe'));const y=new Date().getFullYear();const l=await (await fetch('/api/hr/vacations?year='+y,{headers:h})).json();let ok=true;for(const x of l.filter(x=>x.employeeId===q.e))ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/vacations/'+x.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok;ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/vacation-kinds/'+q.v+'/grants',{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok;ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds/'+q.k,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok;ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/vacation-kinds/'+q.v,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok;ok=(await fetch('/api/employees/'+q.e,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok;sessionStorage.setItem('qaLeClean',String(ok));return true})()
